name: Klaus-Dieter Lehmann
bio:
Klaus-Dieter's motorsport journey began in his youth, captivated by the roar of engines at the Nürburgring. He initially pursued a career as a race engineer, honing his technical skills with various smaller teams before transitioning to management. He's known for his meticulous preparation and data-driven approach, always striving for incremental gains that can translate into significant performance improvements. His ability to foster collaboration between the technical and racing teams is a key asset.

He joined CLRT by Almeras five years ago, initially as a senior engineer, quickly rising through the ranks due to his leadership qualities and ability to resolve conflicts. Klaus-Dieter believes in empowering his team members, giving them the autonomy to take ownership of their work while providing guidance and support when needed. He is a firm believer in the importance of a strong team dynamic and open communication, often organizing team-building events to foster camaraderie.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed back with a slight receding hairline
physical.description: Klaus-Dieter is of average height with a slightly stocky build.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with technical diagrams and notes.
Insists on drinking a specific brand of herbal tea before every race.
Has a habit of tapping his pen rhythmically when deep in thought.
